name: Bank Account Comparison
description: Defines criteria for evaluating checking and savings accounts (fees, APY, minimums, ATM access, features) and applies them to options the user provides. Produces a weighted comparison matrix so the user can select the account that best fits their banking needs. Use when the user asks about choosing a bank account, comparing checking or savings accounts, or evaluating account features and fees. Do NOT use for investment account comparison (use investing skills), business bank accounts, or credit card comparison.
